Washed Denim is an easy family layer built around one relaxed sleeveless vest silhouette for both kids and adults. The faded blue wash, visible topstitching, and utility-style pockets give the look a casual vintage feel that photographs beautifully without feeling overdone. It works well for family portraits, travel days, and those in-between seasons when everyone wants one coordinated layer.

The attached chart publishes only garment length, chest*2, recommended height, and recommended weight across one child ladder and one adult ladder. That means the vest is the only garment the source evidence actually supports on this run, so the white tee and jeans shown in the photos are treated as styling only. The operator request said `PRIMARY_CATEGORY: Set`, but this listing is intentionally published as a vest to stay aligned with the vendor-backed measurements and avoid inventing unsupported pieces.

Key Features:

  • One coordinated family layer: Matching sleeveless vest for kids and adults in the same washed-denim story.
  • Easy transitional styling: Sleeveless construction makes it simple to layer over tees, knits, or lightweight dresses.
  • Relaxed fit evidence: The supplied try-on notes show a loose fit on the boy, mom, and dad, with the girl landing closer to true-to-size.
  • Photo-ready denim wash: Faded blue shading, visible topstitching, and patch pockets give the vest a soft vintage mood.
  • Honest single-garment scope: This listing covers the denim vest only; the white tee and jeans shown in the photos are not included.
